  <h1>Adnan Ghribi</h1>
  <p class="role">Accelerator physicist at GANIL (CNRS), visiting scientist at CERN</p>
  <p class="bio">I connect models, data and experiments to build explainable, predictive and open science, where artificial intelligence extends physics instead of replacing it.
  From experimental cosmology to particle accelerators: collective effects in the FCC-ee booster, machine learning for superconducting linacs, and the networks that bring the community together.</p>

<p class="kicker" style="margin-top:3rem">Trajectory</p>

## From modelling the real world to integrated scientific intelligence

```{=html}
<div class="path">
  <div class="step" style="--c:#1f3a5f"><span class="when">2006 to 2015</span><h3>Experimental cosmology</h3><p class="where">QUBIC · POLARBEAR · LiteBIRD</p><p>Design, integration and deployment of instruments for CMB polarisation, from the lab to the Atacama desert.</p></div>
  <div class="step" style="--c:#f26b38"><span class="when">2015 to 2020</span><h3>Multiphysics modelling</h3><p class="where">SPIRAL2 · GRAAL</p><p>Thermal, mechanical and fluid models of the SPIRAL2 superconducting linac, confronted with operation data. Scientific lead of GRAAL.</p></div>
  <div class="step" style="--c:#13a3a3"><span class="when">2020 to now</span><h3>Future particle accelerators</h3><p class="where">FCC-ee</p><p>Collective effects in the FCC-ee high energy booster with CEA/LEDA and CERN, on Jean Zay, Adastra, CC-IN2P3, LXPLUS and CRIANN.</p></div>
  <div class="step" style="--c:#43a547"><span class="when">2020 to now</span><h3>Scientific AI and intelligent infrastructures</h3><p class="where">M4CAST · MLAcc · ARTIFACT</p><p>Hybrid models, virtual observers and anomaly detection. National and European networks for data, simulation and AI.</p></div>
</div>
```
